subject: [PATCH v3 6/6] btrfs: pre-allocate delayed dir index for non-overwrite rename

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch adds a feature to the Btrfs file system that allows pre-allocating delayed directory index resources before making any btree modifications during non-overwrite renames. This change helps prevent ENOMEM errors by ensuring that the necessary resources are available before attempting to modify the btree. The patch introduces a new function, `btrfs_prealloc_delayed_dir_index`, which is called in the `btrfs_rename` function when there is no overwrite target. If pre-allocation fails, an -ENOMEM error is returned immediately. For overwrite renames, the transaction still aborts on ENOMEM if earlier unlink operations have made irreversible btree modifications.
